a: cwnd limits how much data TCP sends before ACK.
Flow control prevents overwhelming a slow receiver.
HoL blocking delays later messages behind an earlier stalled one.
QUIC reduces connection latency and avoids TCP HoL on streams.
DNS caching speeds lookups but can delay record updates.
Anycast can fail over by routing to another announcement.
BGP hijacks misroute traffic; monitoring and RPKI help.
TLS 1.3 simplifies the handshake and removes old ciphers.
CT logs public certificates to detect mis-issuance.
